cross.interpretation: No new raw-input loss met the predeclared S@9 gain without S@5 regression; no second training round launched. Use fixed-query and input controls to guide next work.

within.interpretation: Round1 improvement did not replicate as a positive S@9 difference; no robust winner established.

decision.rule: After round1 raw-input100scene evaluation, choose perprotocol loss maximizing (S9,S5,S3), preferring L1 on exactties. A newloss qualifies for seed1 replication only if S9>L1 and S5>=L1. If anyqualify, train paired freshL1 and qualifyingloss for eachqualifyingprotocol with initializer7920 and independent deterministic episode draws;same frozenQ0. If none, no extra training. In allcases evaluate round1 MSE/SmoothL1 with centered andzero inputs to test whether improvement needs residualcontent.

limits: Adaptive diagnostics do not prove causality
Loss magnitude andgradient scale not assumed equivalent
No semantic claim from zero-intervention alone
